about_lead: A final-year Multimedia Communication & Design student at CIT Kokrajhar, Assam, and a freelance designer and developer.
about_body: For me, design sits at the sweet spot between engineering and marketing. You can't just solve a problem. You also introduce the product in a way that it sits in the customer's mind. Solving a problem doesn't mean joining wires. It can be sketching a line.
